swimming_pool.evidence: Bright blue rectangular water surface with surrounding patio just northwest of the house, inside the yellow outline.

detached_structure.evidence: A small gazebo or pavilion-like structure with a lighter roof sits northeast of the main house, inside the outline, though it may be an attached patio feature.
